versions.changelog:
- No code or content changes detected in this release.
- Version updated without modifications to functionality or documentation.
- All workflows and feature descriptions remain unchanged.

Initial release with support for Chinese invention patent and software copyright document preparation:

- Generates Chinese invention patent disclosure (交底书) following official format, including invention points, technical solutions, claims, and diagrams.
- Prepares full set of software copyright (软著) application materials, such as design documentation and checklist.
- Supports both separate and integrated workflows for patent and copyright requests.
- Provides detailed prompts to gather required technical and applicant information.
- Outputs structured docx files formatted per regulatory requirements, including diagrams if provided.
- Supplies step-by-step checklist with guidance for user-prepared and system-generated items.
